<ticket id="t007">
THIS IS RIDICULOUS. You charged me $120 for the annual plan when I clearly cancelled in March. I have the confirmation email. If this is not reversed today I am disputing it with my bank.
</ticket>

input.task: Classify ticket t007: customer says they were charged $120 for the annual plan after cancelling in March, has a confirmation email, and threatens a bank dispute if not reversed today. Return the category and priority.

For ticket t007, look up the account's cancellation history (March cancellation date and status), and the $120 annual plan charge (date, status, whether it was processed after cancellation). Report the facts only.

content.content: Ticket t007 (billing, urgent) contains only the customer's message: they say they were charged $120 for the annual plan after cancelling in March, that they have a confirmation email, and that they will dispute the charge with their bank if it is not reversed today. The available tools have no cancellation records, charge date, charge status, or account history, so I could not verify the March cancellation or whether the charge was processed after it. A search for related tickets found no other record for this account, though t042 describes a similar post-cancellation charge with no link to t007 established.

input.task: Write a reply to ticket t007 (billing, urgent). Acknowledge the $120 annual plan charge and the customer's claim that they cancelled in March. Say we are reviewing the account and cancellation records now, ask them to send the confirmation email (date and any reference number), and say we will follow up. Do not promise a refund, reversal, date, or fix, and do not comment on the bank dispute beyond acknowledging it.

content.content: Thank you for reaching out, and I'm sorry for the frustration this charge has caused. We're reviewing your account and cancellation records for the $120 annual plan charge and your March cancellation now. To help us match it up, please reply with a copy of the confirmation email, including its date and any reference number, and we'll follow up with you once our review is complete.
